_doc.purpose: Curated GitHub fixture mirroring demo/data/events.json exactly — 10 services, same envs, same sha/ref/version/actor/status outcomes.
_doc.f10: payments-api has a full dev→staging→qa→preprod→prod deployment-job needs chain. auth-bff, catalog-edge, ledger-projector, notification-worker, order-svc also have multi-env needs chains matching their events.json topologies.
_doc.f15: search-indexer uses artifact:version.txt on every deployment (F15). Artifact content matches the version string from events.json.
_doc.status_states: in-progress events from events.json → single in_progress GitHub status (no terminal). success/failure events → in_progress + terminal status.
_doc.run_ids: run_id values are taken from events.json run_number fields so target_url patterns are consistent.
_doc.multi_run: Services with multiple runs (auth-bff: 3300/3210/3200, order-svc: 2960/2940/2920, etc.) have a deployment object per run per env. The fetcher backfill picks the newest per (service, env).
_doc.disconnected: billing-webhook has five separate run_ids (one per env) — fully disconnected as in events.json.
_doc.target_url: Every status target_url embeds /actions/runs/{run_id} for fetcher §5.6.1 run-id extraction.
_doc.ingest_window: Timestamps are relative-shifted to seed-time at load by GithubFixtureLoader — the newest event always anchors to ~now so the dataset never ages out of INITIAL_LOOKBACK=7d. Relative spacing of all events is preserved exactly. billing-webhook/prod run 792001 is ~12 days before the newest event; it remains outside the 7-day window after shift by design.

new_statuses.pending: payments-api prod run 4840 — single 'pending' status → maps to contract 'pending'. run 4830 'success' is the effective slot; run 4840 is the incoming next.
new_statuses.queued: search-indexer prod run 1420 — single 'queued' status → maps to contract 'queued'.
new_statuses.waiting: billing-webhook prod run 826 — single 'waiting' status → maps to contract 'waiting'.
new_statuses.cancelled: ledger-projector prod run 1831 — 'failure' status + run_conclusion 'cancelled' → fetcher ResolveFailureStatusAsync detects cancelled run → contract 'cancelled'.
new_statuses.rejected: catalog-edge prod run 5161 — 'failure' status + reviews [{state: rejected}] → fetcher reviews endpoint → contract 'rejected'.
